title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-3923, located at 3760 North Dover Street, easterly of Boyce Avenue.
text:
[Council File 26-1430; CD 13]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-3923, located at 3760 North Dover Street, easterly of Boyce Avenue.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-3923, located at 3760 North Dover Street, easterly of Boyce Avenue and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
Owner: Margaret P. Goddard; Surveyor: Frank J. Sobecki
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $16,500 for the processing of this final parcel map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted.
summary: Council is asked to approve the final parcel map for a property at 3760 North Dover Street, east of Boyce Avenue, along with its subdivision improvement agreement.

locations.text: 3760 N Dover St, Los Angeles, CA

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 13, 2026)
